syn: Re:ZERO ~Starting Break Time From Zero~ 2nd Season
d.synopsis: Afraid that his life may end at any moment, Otto Suwen begins writing a diary documenting all of his experiences. Now part of Subaru Natsuki's eccentric band of colorful characters, the apprehensive merchant is certain that new dangers lie ahead in their mission at Sanctuary. But amid the rising tensions, there are still moments of respite and reflection, ripe with opportunities to make vivid memories.
